title: Cops Find Florida Couple Stabbed in Quiet Neighborhood
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida police investigating the stabbings of a retired couple on New Year’s Eve. Their neighbors called 911 after finding the 80-year-old Sharon Getman and 83-year-old Darryl Getman dead in their Mount Dora home. The investigation developed quickly after they spotted the couple’s stolen car in Georgia. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Watch More Police Bodycam Videos: https://bit.ly/WatchBodycamVideos

Law&Crime is the leading multi-platform network that covers live court video, high-profile criminal trials, crazy crime, and smart legal analysis. Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
